[Story]
Over the weekend, Xiaofang and her mother move into a new house, they go to the shopping center together to buy some blue curtains. On Monday afternoon, Xiaofang hangs the new curtains on the windows of her bedroom. After hanging them up, she happily says to her mother: "Mom, the new curtains look really good." Her mother smiles and says: "Yes, the blue matches Xiaofang's bedroom." After a while, Xiaofang's best friend Xiaolan comes to the new house to play, after seeing the curtains, she says: "Oh, the color of these curtains is too ugly, I think you should buy new ones." Xiaofang doesn't say anything, after a while she asks: "So, do you think the other parts of my bedroom are okay?"

[Question]
If there is, which sentence is inappropriate?

[Candidate Answers]
A. Oh, the color of this curtain is too ugly, I think you should buy a new one.
B. There is no inappropriate sentence.
C. So, do you think the other parts of my bedroom are okay?
D. Mom, the new curtains look really good.
